name: MANTAS T-12

placement_rationale.text: 83 km sits well inside MANTAS T-12's own sourced 250 km range (MARTAC Systems; Naval Technology), consistent with doctrine.md §2's medium/long-range strike & recon band (10–150+ km) rather than being pushed to the edge of its envelope. As a Western-donated multi-role patrol/intercept USV operating alongside Ukraine's domestic strike-focused fleet, sitting closer to zero than Magura V5's deeper strike-run placement (120 km) while staying well beyond FPV/close-reconnaissance range is consistent with faster, more general-purpose patrol tasking rather than the deepest one-way strike profile.

characteristics: Strength: Higher speed than Sonobot-5, suited to faster patrol/intercept-style tasking
Limitation: Range shorter than Magura V5's 800km strike-optimized profile
Estimated quantity available: Donated numbers not fully disclosed
employment_notes: Donated Western USV adding patrol/multi-role capability alongside Ukraine's domestic strike-focused USV fleet
contrast_vs_traditional: MANTAS extends the same USV logic Ukraine's larger kamikaze naval drones (like Magura) have already demonstrated at Black Sea scale: a multi-role uncrewed surface vessel doing reconnaissance or strike work a traditional navy would have risked a crewed patrol boat on, at a fraction of the cost and none of the crew risk if it's lost.
